	scope:selected_mage = { is_alive = yes omni_character_is_eligible_caster = yes }
	scope:selected_mage = { omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = dragonscale_shield_dragonscale } }
	scope:selected_mage = { omni_can_afford_spell = { BASE = 75 } }
	scope:selected_mage = {
	    has_variable = dragonscale_unlocked_var
	}
}

omni_sb_can_cast_dreaming = {
	scope:selected_mage = { is_alive = yes omni_sb_viewer_controls = yes omni_character_is_eligible_caster = yes omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = dreaming } }
	scope:selected_mage = {
	    trigger_if = {
	        limit = { has_variable = omni_folk_practitioner }
	        omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = dreaming }
	    }
	}
	scope:selected_mage = { is_alive = yes omni_character_is_eligible_caster = yes }
	scope:selected_mage = { has_variable = dreaming_known_var }
	scope:selected_mage = { omni_can_afford_spell = { BASE = 50 } }
	scope:selected_mage = {
	    OR = {
	        omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = dreaming }
	        OR = {
	            has_culture = siamiu
	            has_culture = galidai
	            has_culture = yoviugi
	            has_culture = brusian
	            has_culture = old_polari
	        }
	    }
	}
}

omni_sb_can_cast_explosion = {
	scope:selected_mage = { is_alive = yes omni_sb_viewer_controls = yes omni_character_is_eligible_caster = yes omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = explosion } }
	scope:selected_mage = { any_character_unit = { is_army = yes unit_location = { owner = { war_with = root } NOT = { has_province_modifier = shoishoni_folk_mod } } } }
	scope:selected_mage = {
	    trigger_if = {
	        limit = { has_variable = omni_folk_practitioner }
	        omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = explosion }
	    }
	}
	scope:selected_mage = { is_alive = yes omni_character_is_eligible_caster = yes }
	scope:selected_mage = { any_character_unit = { is_army = yes unit_location = { owner = { war_with = root } NOT = { has_province_modifier = shoishoni_folk_mod } } } }
	scope:selected_mage = { omni_can_afford_spell = { BASE = 75 } }
	scope:selected_mage = {
	    OR = {
	        omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = explosion }
	        has_culture = shoishoni
	    }
	}
}

	scope:selected_mage = {
	    OR = {
	        omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = stinging_nettles }
	        OR = {
	            has_culture = admadi
	            has_culture = bogdian
	            has_culture = hiari
	            has_culture = senekeloi
	            has_culture = sidhioi
	            has_culture = semeladin
	            has_culture = iyusavr
	        }
	    }
	}
}

	scope:target = { any_character_unit = { OR = { is_army = yes is_navy = yes } } }
}
